data.name: Everglades Airboat and Wildlife Sanctuary with round-trip transportation
data.headline: Round-trip bus transfer from Miami to the Everglades with a guided, mostly covered airboat tour, wildlife presentation, and free time at the sanctuary
data.description: Embark on a seamless adventure from Miami Beach or downtown Miami aboard a climate-controlled coach to the Florida Everglades. Enjoy a guided, mostly covered airboat tour led by a local park ranger who shares insights into the wetlands and points out native wildlife and birds. Experience a brief, educational wildlife presentation featuring rescued alligators, then relax with free time to explore park exhibits, visit the snack bar, or shop for souvenirs before returning to Miami. Wildlife sightings vary with seasonal conditions.

data.highlights:
* Guided airboat safari led by a local park ranger
* Educational wildlife presentation with rescued alligator encounters
* Opportunity to spot native wildlife and exotic birds in their natural habitat
* Free time to explore park exhibits, snack bar, and souvenirs
* Airboats may be covered for sun and weather protection and vary in size depending on group size from 12 to 30 guests
data.itinerary:
1. Pick up from selected meeting point by bus
2. Ca. 50–90 minute bus transfer to the Everglades depending on traffic and pick-up location
3. Ca. 45 minute airboat ride
4. Brief wildlife presentation and introduction at the sanctuary
5. Ca. 45–60 minute free time to explore exhibits, snack bar, souvenir shop and restrooms
6. Ca. 50–90 minute bus transfer back to Miami
7. Return to your original tour starting point

meeting_point.address: 700 Collins Avenue Miami Beach, FL US 33139

data.cancellation_summary: Full refund if canceled at least 24 hours in advance
data.check_in_details: Wait outside on the street sidewalk at your selected meeting point at your scheduled pickup time. Bus arrival may vary within a 15-minute window; pickup runs north to south. Travel time to the Everglades is 75–100 minutes each way depending on traffic. Arrive at your meeting point about 10 minutes early for scheduled pickup.
data.restrictions: Most airboats are covered for sun, rain and lightning protection. The Everglades are a natural ecosystem; wildlife sightings are not guaranteed and captive animals on-site are rescues under government care.
data.disclaimers: Travel time varies with traffic; bus transfer can take approximately 75–100 minutes each way. The Everglades are a natural ecosystem and animal sightings cannot be guaranteed. Current seasonal climate and water levels may make wild alligator sightings rare. Any animals in captivity at the park are rescues monitored by government wildlife agencies. Airboats may be covered for sun and weather protection and vary in size depending on group size from 12 to 30 guests.
